name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's motorsport journey began unexpectedly. While serving his mandatory military service, his aptitude for vehicle mechanics was quickly recognized, leading to his placement in the motor pool. After his service, he honed his skills at a local tuning shop before being scouted by a junior single-seater team. His meticulous approach to data analysis and driver feedback made him an invaluable asset, quickly moving him up the ranks.

As Alpine F1's test driver coordinator, Park is known for his relentless pursuit of improvement. He meticulously analyzes every test run, working closely with both the drivers and engineering teams to identify areas for optimization. He is a firm believer in the power of clear communication and fostering a collaborative environment, ensuring that every member of the test team is working towards a common goal. Park's ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights for drivers is what truly sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A medium-built man with a serious expression, often seen with a tablet in hand.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Insists on drinking green tea brewed at exactly 80 degrees Celsius before every test session.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
